past.filename: Keili-07455.jpg
past.title: Live Music | Keilimei
past.body:
Keilimei Solo & Duo 

Keilimei is a vocalist, songwriter and performer born and raised in Hawaii. She grew a love for timeless romantic melodies after spending 10 years in France and learning the language. She captivates audiences around the world with her enchanting dreamy vocals and playful banter. Having toured extensively around France with the French Duo Synapson and performing at various apres-ski resorts in the French Alps, she is well versed in various genres, from Bossanova to Deep House. Her solo acts include ambient vocals and an amalgamation of R&B, Folk and French songs accompanied by her mini electric guitar. 

n Duo with Tracy Kim, expect Jazz standards, Cheeky Banter, and Romantic songs in English & French.  

Spotify: Keilimei

Instagram: @portlandjazz @keilimei

past.title: Live Music | Pete Krebs Duo
past.body: Pete Krebs has been a member of the Portland, Oregon musical community since 1988. His bands Hazel, Golden Delicious, The Stolen Sweets, The Portland Playboys and The Catnip Brothers have explored genres as diverse as punk rock, gypsy jazz, western swing and vintage jazz, traditional folk and country. His discography contains dozens of releases on a variety of labels including Cavity Search, Rough Trade and Sub Pop.

past.title: Live Music: Dani Joy and Perry Stauffer
past.body: Dani Joy is a spellbinding singer-songwriter with a voice like velvet, offering Latin rhythms and vintage throwbacks. Perry Stauffer is a versatile multi-instrumentalist with a passion for Jazz and American roots music. They will be joined by local artist Miles Bolder on violin.

past.filename: ClayGiberson&JessieMarquez.JPG
past.title: Live Music | Jessie Marquez Duo
past.body:
Enjoy the sound of local musicians.

Latin jazz vocalist Jessie Marquez blends Cuban, Brazilian, jazz and pop sounds for music with lush harmonies and cool grooves. While her themes revolve around love and longing, her soothing vocals are a balm for any heart. Marquez got on-the-job training in Havana, where she recorded with members of the Afro Cuban Allstars. Sana Locura (2004) reached the top of Latin jazz and Salsa charts in the US and Europe. A frequent visitor to the island, she has appeared on Cuban television and radio and has performed throughout the country.

past.filename: Torre_de_Oña__8.jpg.2000x0_q85_crop.jpg
past.title: Judgment Of Paris 50th anniversary Rematch!
past.body:
Try a flight of six benchmark wines from some of the great producers of France, Oregon and California. The only Catch is we wont tell you which is which!

You will Vote for your favorite white and favorite red, at the end we will tally everyone’s vote and see who the true top dog is!

50 years ago one of the most important events for American wine occurred. Steven Spurrier put on a contest between new and up and coming California against the Legendary Houses of France. To everyone’s shock California won both categories!

This Launched an explosion of interest and appreciation of California wine, and wine from America in general.

50 years later we are celebrating this accomplishment.
past.excerpt: Rematch of the Judgement of Paris! Sunday May 24th.
